# /render-video

Render an existing HTML deck or magazine as an MP4 with Hyperframes. Use `/generate-video` to start from a topic instead.

**Input:** a path to an HTML file already generated by this skill.
**Output:** one MP4 in `~/.agent/videos/<slug>.mp4` plus 3 keyframe PNGs.
Render time depends on scene count, duration, and entrance animations.

**Source/artifact contract.** Render generated HTML artifacts. If the user gives a `.mdx` or `.tsx` deck source, export it first with `npm run ve:export`. If the render requires a custom Hyperframes composition, write that composition as TSX and export static generated HTML with `npm run ve:export-static -- <composition.tsx> --out ~/.agent/videos/<slug>/index.html`. The generated HTML is the Hyperframes input artifact; the editable source remains MDX/TSX.

## Workflow

### 1. Clarify

Use the supplied style, narration, and duration. Apply `references/clarify.md` only when a material choice remains unresolved; defaults do not require reconfirmation.

### 2. Check prerequisites

```bash
bash {{skill_dir}}/scripts/hyperframes-doctor.sh
```

Missing upstream skills produce non-fatal warnings. Use `/hyperframes`, `/hyperframes-cli`, and `/gsap` when installed; otherwise use the local references. See `references/hyperframes.md` → "Delegation boundary".

### 3. Parse the source deck

Read the generated HTML file. Identify each slide:
- Vertical scroll-snap deck: each `.slide` element with `scroll-snap-align: start`
- Horizontal magazine: each `.page` element with `scroll-snap-align: start`

Extract per-slide:
- Layout class (title, section-divider, content, split, diagram, dashboard, table, code, quote, full-bleed, split-color-block, quadrant, full-bleed-stat, dark-panel)
- Prose content (headings, body copy)
- Any embedded diagrams (Mermaid source, inline SVG, images)
- Background tint / dark-panel flag
- Key stat / hero number if present

### 4. Translate slides → compositions

**For `--style=long-form` (default when each slide should become a scene):**
Every source slide maps to one scene in the Hyperframes composition. Per-scene dwell: 8–12s unless narration audio dictates otherwise. Copy the slide's content into the composition structure used by `templates/hyperframes-longform.html`. Animate per scene:
- Headline: fade-up, staggered
- Body: fade-up
- Sourced values: remain visible and accurate
- Diagram: progressive reveal per `reel-patterns.md` § Progressive Diagram Reveal
- Scene exit: fade-out at scene-end

Insert shader transitions (via `npx hyperframes add flash-through-white` or `domain-warp-dissolve`) between major section boundaries (not between every scene).

**For `--style=reel` (compress a long deck to a 30–45s vertical reel):**
Select the content that fits a 30–45s argument using `reel-patterns.md`. Preserve the problem, mechanism, and supporting evidence; omit slides that do not advance that argument. Use a statistic only when the source supports it and it makes a useful opening.

### 5. Narration

**`--narration=auto`**: Extract the headline + body copy from each scene; emit a narration script. Edit the script before TTS; use `/unslop` when requested and available. Run `npx hyperframes tts` to generate audio.

**`--narration=<path-to-script.txt>`**: Use the user's script verbatim. TTS it.

**`--narration=none`**: No audio track. Silent video.

For reel style, captions are burned in regardless of narration mode (unless `--no-captions`).

### 6. Lint, validate, draft render, keyframes, final render

Same as `/generate-video` steps 5–9:

```bash
cd ~/.agent/videos/<slug>
npx hyperframes lint && npx hyperframes validate
npx hyperframes render --output <slug>-draft.mp4 --quality draft --strict
bash {{skill_dir}}/scripts/extract-keyframes.sh <slug>-draft.mp4
# Inspect keyframes and repair the source before final rendering.
npx hyperframes render --output <slug>.mp4 --quality standard --strict
```

### 7. Deliver

Report: final MP4 path, duration, size, first keyframe as thumbnail. Note which source slides didn't make the cut (reel style) so the user knows what was compressed away.

## Mapping Table — Slide Types → Composition Patterns

| Source slide type | Long-form scene | Reel beat |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Scene 1 (headline + supporting text fade-up) | HOOK (if it has a stat) or intro card before HOOK |
| Section Divider | Short scene with shader transition in | Skipped (reel doesn't section-divide) |
| Content | Standard scene (headline + body) | CONTEXT or RESOLUTION |
| Split | Two-column scene with staggered fade-up per side | Skipped (reel is single-focal) |
| Diagram | Progressive diagram reveal scene | MECHANISM |
| Dashboard | Show the source measurements and their units | PROOF (select one supported result) |
| Table | Row-by-row stagger | Skipped (reel can't read tables) |
| Code | Syntax-highlighted fade-in | Skipped unless 1–2 lines |
| Quote | Italic serif fade-up | CONTEXT or RESOLUTION |
| Full-Bleed | Ken Burns on imagery | HOOK background |
| full-bleed-stat | Keep the value and its context readable | HOOK, when the value supports it |
| split-color-block | Two-color fade-up | Skipped (compress to single-focal) |
| quadrant | 2×2 staggered fade-scale | MECHANISM or PROOF |
| dark-panel | Dark scene with headline | PROBLEM or RESOLUTION |

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `--style=<long-form\|reel>` | long-form | Long-form maps 1:1; reel compresses |
| `--narration=<auto\|path\|none>` | auto | `auto` generates TTS from scene copy |
| `--voice=<name>` | `af_nova` | Hyperframes TTS voice |
| `--duration=<Ns>` | scene-count × dwell (long-form) or 45s (reel) | |
| `--no-captions` | off | Reel only; default is captions on |
| `--quality=<draft\|standard\|high>` | standard | |
| `--fps=<24\|30\|60>` | 30 | |
| `--no-ask` | off | Use defaults for optional choices |
